answers.valueEn: The car is original paint with agency maintenance. Bump on the front right fender, bump on the right side sill. Bulge in front right tire. Front pads average with slight scoring, rear pads average with high scoring. Rear wiper arm cover missing. Piece missing in rear bumper, bumper plug needs fixing. Scratches at the bottom of the front bumper. Rear tires showing cracking, fine cracks, and expiry. Broken fuel tank cover mechanism. Scratches and minor break in front bumper skirt mount. Minor crack in engine guard mount. Scratches and bumps in fiber under-guards. Small cut in right side fiber guard. Cracking and cutting in 2 front control arm bushings. Cracking in lower gearbox mount bushing. Cracking and cutting in upper engine mount with sagging. Teflon on the engine oil plug.
